QuestInfo.name: Trails of the Flame
QuestInfo.0: #bOz#k is looking for you. Go to #bEreve#k.
QuestInfo.1:
Oz is the youngest member of a family of renowned wizards.

She grew up with much love and support from her entire family, and she joined the Knights when her teacher noticed her overwhelming talent at the Magic School. With hard work and determination, she was able to develop her awesome skills.
QuestInfo.2: When she joined the Knights, Oz's parents wanted to make sure she was well-fed, and started sending her huge care packages. Since she can never finish them all herself, she shares with everyone.
